questions.question: Analyze the museum visitor data to identify key trends and differences between museums.

answer.value: The museum visitor data reveals significant differences in popularity and visitation patterns: 1) Avila Adobe is the most popular museum with 1,419,638 total visitors (24,061.66 average monthly), followed by America Tropical Interpretive Center (419,314), Firehouse Museum (381,897), and Chinese American Museum (160,554). 2) Avila Adobe's visitor numbers are more than three times higher than the next museum, indicating its dominant position. 3) Firehouse Museum shows a significant outlier in September 2014 with 61,192 visitors, possibly due to a special event. 4) All museums show seasonal patterns with higher visitation in spring and summer months. 5) Chinese American Museum has the lowest overall visitation but shows growth potential with peaks in March 2016 (7,702 visitors).

key_insights: Avila Adobe is the most popular museum with 1,419,638 total visitors
Firehouse Museum had a significant outlier in September 2014 with 61,192 visitors
All museums show seasonal patterns with higher visitation in spring and summer
Chinese American Museum has the lowest overall visitation but shows growth potential
